Exceeds Expectations: Title clearly reflects specific research questions; author(s) properly credited.
Meets Expectations: Title reflects general research topic; author(s) credited.
Does Not Meet Expectations: Title is missing or does not reflect research topic; author(s) not credited.

Exceeds Expectations: Provides a numbered list of at least 3 well-defined, answerable research questions with 1–3 sentence descriptions.
Meets Expectations: Provides a numbered list of 3 research questions with brief descriptions; questions are somewhat clear.
Does Not Meet Expectations: Provides fewer than 3 research questions; questions are vague or lack descriptions.

Exceeds Expectations: Clearly articulates the significance of the research questions in 1–2 well-developed paragraphs; explains relevance and potential impact.
Meets Expectations: Provides a general explanation of the significance of the research questions; relevance is somewhat clear.
Does Not Meet Expectations: Motivation is unclear or missing; does not explain the significance of the research questions.

Requirement: Dataset Description For webscraping challenge; document the site for scraping URLs and expected format of future scraped data.
Exceeds Expectations: Thoroughly describes dataset(s) including exact URLs; dataset is real, contains over 500 lines, and is appropriate for research; explains data source, collection methods, and potential limitations. Deep understanding and documentation of data columns, formats, accuracy and caveats
Meets Expectations: Describes dataset(s) with URLs; dataset meets basic requirements; provides some information on data source and collection methods.
Does Not Meet Expectations: Inadequate description of dataset(s); missing URLs; dataset is inappropriate or insufficient for research; lacks information on data source and collection methods.

Exceeds Expectations: Selects at least 2 appropriate challenge goals; provides strong justification for their relevance and suitability to the project.
Meets Expectations: Selects 2 challenge goals; provides some justification for their selection.
Does Not Meet Expectations: Fails to select appropriate challenge goals; justification is weak or missing.

Exceeds Expectations: Documentation is well-organized, free of grammatical errors, and formatted professionally; tables and figures (if any) are clear and enhance understanding. All sections are complete with sufficient details (such as: Task List, Challenges working with the data...)
Meets Expectations: Document is organized and mostly free of grammatical errors; formatting is adequate; tables and figures (if any) are understandable. Some details lacking
Does Not Meet Expectations: Document is poorly organized, contains grammatical errors, and lacks professional formatting; tables and figures (if any) are unclear or absent.
